title: Enterprise Resource Planning
tagline: One system of record for finance, operations and everything in between.
overview: An ERP replaces the patchwork of spreadsheets and disconnected tools with a single system of record — general ledger, procurement, inventory and reporting all pulling from the same data, so finance and operations are never working off different numbers.
features: General ledger and chart of accounts management
Multi-entity and multi-currency consolidation
Accounts payable and receivable automation
Budgeting, forecasting and financial planning tools
Role-based approval and audit workflows
Real-time financial dashboards across departments

process.title: Financial Systems Assessment
process.desc: We map your current chart of accounts, entities and approval chains before recommending a configuration.

process.title: System Configuration
process.desc: Modules, workflows and permission levels are configured to match how your finance team actually operates.

process.title: Data Migration & Validation
process.desc: Historical financial data is migrated and reconciled against source records before go-live.

process.title: Go-Live & Close Support
process.desc: We support your team through the first full month-end close and tune workflows based on what surfaces.

benefits.title: One source of financial truth
benefits.desc: Finance, operations and leadership all report from the same live numbers instead of reconciling spreadsheets.

benefits.title: Faster financial close
benefits.desc: Automated postings and approval routing remove the manual chasing that stretches month-end into weeks.

benefits.title: Fewer reconciliation errors
benefits.desc: Multi-entity and multi-currency consolidation happens automatically instead of in a shared workbook.

faqs.q: Can an ERP integrate with our existing accounting software?
faqs.a: In most cases yes — we assess your current stack during the assessment phase and plan either a migration or an integration, whichever fits your data better.

faqs.q: Does it support multiple entities and currencies?
faqs.a: Yes, multi-entity and multi-currency consolidation is a core capability, not a paid add-on.

faqs.q: Is our historical financial data safe during migration?
faqs.a: Yes — data is migrated to a staging environment and reconciled against your source records before anything goes live.

testimonial.quote: Month-end used to take three weeks and a spreadsheet nobody fully trusted. Now finance closes in days, off numbers everyone agrees on.
testimonial.author: Client Name

title: Business Intelligence & Analytics
tagline: Turn scattered data into decisions you can actually act on.
overview: A BI platform pulls data out of every system you run — ERP, billing, sales, operations — and turns it into dashboards people actually check, replacing the monthly export-and-pivot-table ritual with numbers that update themselves.
features: Custom dashboards and KPI tracking by department
Drag-and-drop report builder for non-technical users
Automated data refresh from every connected system
Predictive analytics and trend forecasting
Role-based data access and permissioning
Scheduled report distribution by email or Slack

process.title: Data Source Audit
process.desc: We catalog every system holding data worth reporting on, and assess how clean and consistent that data actually is.

process.title: Dashboard Design
process.desc: Dashboards are built around the specific decisions each team needs to make, not a generic template.

process.title: Integration & Automation
process.desc: Every data source is connected and refresh schedules are set so dashboards stay current without manual exports.

process.title: Go-Live & Training
process.desc: We train each team on their dashboards and tune what's shown based on what they actually use in the first weeks.

benefits.title: Faster, better decisions
benefits.desc: Leadership sees current numbers instead of a report that was accurate two weeks ago when it was pulled.

benefits.title: Hours back from manual reporting
benefits.desc: Dashboards that update themselves remove the recurring task of exporting and rebuilding the same spreadsheet.

benefits.title: One version of the truth
benefits.desc: Every department pulls from the same underlying data, so sales and finance stop arguing about whose number is right.

faqs.q: Can BI dashboards pull from systems you didn't build?
faqs.a: Yes — we regularly connect BI to third-party CRMs, marketplaces and legacy databases alongside the systems we build ourselves.

faqs.q: Do non-technical staff need help building reports?
faqs.a: The drag-and-drop builder is designed for business users, though we're happy to build the first set of dashboards for you directly.

faqs.q: How current is the data on the dashboards?
faqs.a: Refresh frequency is configurable per source, from real-time to scheduled intervals, depending on how time-sensitive that data actually is.

testimonial.quote: We used to spend the first two days of every month building the board deck. Now the numbers are already sitting there, current, when we open the dashboard.
testimonial.author: Client Name

title: Subscription & Invoicing Engines
tagline: Every invoice, subscription and renewal, handled automatically.
overview: A billing engine automates recurring invoicing, subscription lifecycle changes and revenue recognition — so a customer upgrading, downgrading or cancelling mid-cycle is handled by the system correctly, instead of by someone manually prorating an invoice.
features: Recurring, usage-based and hybrid billing models
Automated invoice generation and delivery
Subscription lifecycle management — upgrades, downgrades, cancellations
Dunning management for failed and late payments
Automated tax calculation and compliance
Revenue recognition reporting for accrual accounting

process.title: Billing Model Audit
process.desc: We document your current plans, pricing tiers and proration rules before configuring anything.

process.title: Plan & Pricing Setup
process.desc: Subscription plans, usage tiers and proration logic are configured to match your actual pricing structure.

process.title: Payment & Tax Integration
process.desc: Billing is connected to your payment gateway and tax engine so invoices calculate and collect correctly the first time.

process.title: Go-Live & Reconciliation
process.desc: We monitor the first billing cycles closely and reconcile collected revenue against what was invoiced.

benefits.title: Fewer billing errors and disputes
benefits.desc: Automated proration and invoice generation remove the manual math that causes most billing complaints.

benefits.title: Less involuntary churn
benefits.desc: Dunning workflows retry and follow up on failed payments automatically, before a customer is lost to a card that just expired.

benefits.title: Clean, audit-ready revenue reporting
benefits.desc: Revenue recognition follows accounting standards automatically instead of being reconstructed at year-end.

faqs.q: Can it handle usage-based and tiered pricing, not just flat subscriptions?
faqs.a: Yes — usage-based, tiered and hybrid billing models are all core capabilities, not custom work.

faqs.q: What happens when a customer's payment fails?
faqs.a: A configurable dunning sequence retries the payment and notifies the customer automatically, with manual follow-up only for accounts that need it.
Yes, tax calculation is integrated per region and updates automatically as tax rules change.

testimonial.quote: Failed payments used to just quietly turn into lost customers. Now the system chases them down before we even notice, and we keep the revenue.
testimonial.author: Client Name

title: Payment Gateway Integrations
overview: A payment gateway integration connects your storefront and billing system to the processors, banks and wallets your customers actually want to pay with — handling tokenization, fraud checks and settlement so a failed or fraudulent transaction is caught before it becomes a chargeback.
features: Multi-gateway support (Stripe, PayPal, Razorpay and others)
PCI-DSS compliant card tokenization
Multi-currency and cross-border payment acceptance
Real-time fraud detection and risk scoring
Automated settlement reconciliation against your ledger
Smart retry logic for declined transactions

process.title: Payment Flow Audit
process.desc: We review your current checkout flow, gateways and decline rates before recommending changes.

process.title: Gateway Integration
process.desc: Your chosen gateways are integrated with tokenization and routing rules configured around cost and approval rates.

process.title: Security & Compliance Review
process.desc: PCI-DSS compliance and fraud rules are reviewed and tested before any live traffic runs through the integration.

process.title: Go-Live & Monitoring
process.desc: We monitor approval rates and settlement accuracy closely in the first weeks and tune fraud thresholds as needed.

benefits.title: Higher payment success rates
benefits.desc: Smart retry logic and multi-gateway routing recover transactions that would otherwise fail outright.

benefits.title: Reduced fraud exposure
benefits.desc: Real-time risk scoring flags suspicious transactions before they settle, instead of after a chargeback arrives.

benefits.title: Faster settlement reconciliation
benefits.desc: Payments reconcile automatically against your ledger instead of someone matching bank statements by hand.

faqs.q: Can we use more than one payment gateway at once?
faqs.a: Yes — multi-gateway routing is built in, so you can route by region, cost or approval rate rather than committing to a single processor.

faqs.q: Is card data stored on our servers?
faqs.a: No — card data is tokenized through PCI-DSS compliant vaulting, so sensitive payment data never touches your own infrastructure.
Yes, including multi-currency acceptance and settlement, with routing configured around the gateways that perform best in each region.

testimonial.quote: Our decline rate dropped the moment retry logic and gateway routing went live. That's revenue we were simply losing before, for no good reason.
testimonial.author: Client Name
